skeptic.argument: Two of the billing findings rest on the same three lines of markup and one of them is asserted without evidence. The error-states call duplicates the empty-states call in everything but wording.

builder.argument: Half of these recommendations name a quality rather than a change. Anything that cannot be turned into a diff in an afternoon is not a finding yet, it is a mood.

dreamer.argument: Nobody has looked at loading states as a set. Each screen was graded alone, so the inconsistency between them is invisible to every finding on the board.

empath.argument: The ranking serves the reviewer, not the person paying. A billing screen that cannot explain a failed charge outranks every piece of polish above it.
